title: AI Resume Analyzer
description: Build an AI system that analyzes resumes and scores candidates based on job descriptions using NLP and machine learning.
problemStatement: Recruiters spend hours manually screening resumes. This system automates candidate evaluation by extracting skills with NLP and scoring matches against job requirements.
implementationSteps: Set up Python environment and collect sample resumes
Build NLP pipeline for text extraction and preprocessing
Train skill extraction model and implement matching algorithm
Build Flask API and React frontend with upload interface

title: Spam Email Classifier
description: Create a machine learning model that classifies emails as spam or ham using text classification techniques.
problemStatement: Email spam remains a persistent problem. This project builds a Naive Bayes classifier trained on labeled email data to automatically detect and filter spam.
implementationSteps: Load and explore the spam email dataset
Clean text data with tokenization, stopword removal, and stemming
Train Naive Bayes model with TF-IDF features and evaluate metrics
Build a simple Streamlit interface for live predictions

title: Handwritten Digit Recognizer
description: Build a neural network that recognizes handwritten digits from the MNIST dataset with a drawing canvas interface.
problemStatement: Understanding neural networks is fundamental to AI. This project teaches deep learning basics by building a digit classifier with a drawable canvas for real-time predictions.
implementationSteps: Set up Python with TensorFlow and load MNIST dataset
Build and train a simple CNN model on digit images
Evaluate model accuracy and visualize training curves
Create a Tkinter or HTML canvas for live digit recognition

title: Autonomous Drone Navigation System
description: Design a reinforcement learning agent that autonomously navigates a drone through obstacle-rich environments using computer vision.
problemStatement: Autonomous navigation in unstructured environments requires combining computer vision with decision-making. This system uses deep RL to train a drone to navigate and avoid obstacles in real-time.
implementationSteps: Set up ROS simulation environment and define observation/action spaces
Implement DQN agent with experience replay and target networks
Integrate OpenCV-based obstacle detection into the reward function
Train in simulation, fine-tune, and build monitoring dashboard

title: Fake News Detection System
description: Build a deep learning model that detects fake news articles using BERT-based text classification and source credibility analysis.
problemStatement: Misinformation spreads rapidly online. This system uses transfer learning with BERT to classify news articles as real or fake, providing confidence scores and explainability.
implementationSteps: Collect and preprocess labeled fake news dataset
Fine-tune BERT model for binary classification
Build Flask API with prediction endpoint and confidence scoring
Create React frontend with article submission and results display

title: E-commerce Web Platform
description: Build a full-stack e-commerce application with real-time cart, payment integration, and admin analytics dashboard.
problemStatement: Small businesses need affordable online selling platforms. This project builds a complete e-commerce solution with product management, cart persistence, Stripe payments, and sales analytics.
features: Product catalog with search and filters
implementationSteps: Design database schema and set up Express API with authentication
Build product catalog, cart system, and order management APIs
Integrate Stripe payment gateway and implement email notifications
Build React frontend with admin dashboard and deploy

title: Portfolio Generator Website
description: Create a tool that generates personalized portfolio websites from user input with template selection and live preview.
problemStatement: New developers struggle to build portfolios from scratch. This tool lets users fill in their details, choose a template, and instantly preview and export a professional portfolio site.
implementationSteps: Design 3-4 portfolio templates with HTML/CSS
Build input form for user details (name, skills, projects)
Implement dynamic template rendering with JavaScript
Add export functionality to download generated portfolio

title: URL Shortener Service
description: Create a web service that converts long URLs into short links with click tracking, analytics, and QR code generation.
problemStatement: Sharing long URLs is inconvenient and untrackable. This service generates short links with comprehensive click analytics including geographic data and referral sources.
features: Short link generation with custom aliases
implementationSteps: Design MongoDB schema for URLs, clicks, and analytics
Build Express API with short code generation and redirect logic
Implement click tracking middleware with geo-IP lookup
Create React dashboard with Chart.js analytics visualization

title: Real-Time Collaborative Code Editor
description: Build a Google Docs-style collaborative code editor with real-time sync, multi-language support, and integrated terminal.
problemStatement: Remote pair programming lacks seamless real-time collaboration tools. This editor supports simultaneous editing with conflict resolution, syntax highlighting, and shared terminal sessions.
features: Integrated shared terminal with Docker containers
implementationSteps: Set up WebSocket server with CRDT-based conflict resolution
Integrate Monaco Editor with real-time state synchronization
Build Docker-based sandboxed terminal execution environment
Implement user presence system, version history, and deploy

title: Expense Tracker Mobile App
description: Develop a mobile app to track daily expenses with category breakdowns, monthly summaries, and budget alerts.
problemStatement: Managing personal finances manually is tedious and error-prone. This app provides intuitive expense logging with visual breakdowns and spending alerts to help users stay on budget.
implementationSteps: Design mobile UI with Flutter widgets and navigation
Set up Firebase Firestore for expense data storage
Implement CRUD operations and category management
Add chart visualizations and budget alert notifications

title: Todo List App with Local Storage
description: Build a simple but polished todo list mobile app with local storage, categories, and due date reminders.
problemStatement: Learning mobile development requires a hands-on project. This todo app covers core mobile concepts: state management, local storage, notifications, and clean UI design.
implementationSteps: Set up React Native project and design task list UI
Implement task CRUD operations with state management
Add AsyncStorage for persistent local data
Implement due date reminders and deploy to device

title: Fitness Tracking Mobile App
description: Develop a fitness tracking app with workout logging, progress charts, calorie tracking, and personalized goal setting.
problemStatement: Generic fitness apps lack personalization. This app tailors workout tracking and goal-setting to individual fitness levels, providing visual progress tracking and achievement milestones.
implementationSteps: Design mobile UI with workout entry forms and exercise library
Integrate Firebase backend for user data and workout history
Build chart visualizations for progress tracking and calorie data
Implement goal system, achievements, and push notifications

title: Augmented Reality Interior Designer
description: Build a mobile app that lets users place and visualize furniture in their rooms using augmented reality with real-time lighting estimation.
problemStatement: Online furniture shopping lacks spatial context. This app uses AR to let users see exactly how furniture looks in their space before purchasing, with accurate scale and lighting.
features: AR surface detection and object placement
implementationSteps: Set up Unity AR Foundation with ARCore/ARKit for surface detection
Create and import 3D furniture models with Blender
Implement object placement, rotation, and scaling with physics
Build catalog UI, Firebase backend, and deploy to app stores

title: Password Strength Checker
description: Build an interactive tool that evaluates password strength in real-time with visual feedback and improvement suggestions.
problemStatement: Weak passwords are the leading cause of data breaches. This tool educates users about password security by providing instant strength analysis and actionable suggestions.
features: Real-time strength meter with color progression
implementationSteps: Define password strength rules and scoring algorithm
Build responsive UI with animated strength meter
Implement validation logic with regex and dictionary checks
Add suggestion engine and deploy as a static site

title: Two-Factor Authentication System
description: Implement a secure authentication system with TOTP-based two-factor authentication, QR code enrollment, and backup codes.
problemStatement: Password-only authentication is vulnerable to credential stuffing and phishing. This system adds TOTP-based 2FA with QR code setup, making user accounts significantly more secure.
features: QR code generation for authenticator app setup
implementationSteps: Design user authentication flow with JWT and password hashing
Integrate Speakeasy library for TOTP generation and verification
Build QR code enrollment and backup code generation
Implement rate limiting, trusted devices, and deploy

title: Vulnerability Scanner Tool
description: Build a network vulnerability scanner that identifies open ports, known CVEs, and generates detailed security reports.
problemStatement: Small businesses can't afford enterprise security tools. This open-source scanner identifies common vulnerabilities, maps network topology, and generates actionable remediation reports.
features: CVE database lookup for known vulnerabilities
implementationSteps: Build Python wrapper for Nmap with custom scan profiles
Integrate CVE database for vulnerability matching and severity scoring
Create Flask dashboard with scan history and network visualization
Implement PDF report generation and Docker containerization

title: Intrusion Detection System
description: Build an ML-powered intrusion detection system that monitors network traffic in real-time and detects anomalous behavior patterns.
problemStatement: Traditional rule-based IDS miss zero-day attacks. This system uses deep learning on network flow data to detect previously unknown attack patterns with low false positive rates.
features: Attack classification (DDoS, port scan, brute force)
implementationSteps: Set up packet capture pipeline and feature extraction from network flows
Train deep autoencoder on normal traffic and define anomaly thresholds
Build real-time classification pipeline with attack categorization
Integrate ELK Stack dashboard and automated alerting system

title: CSV Data Visualizer
description: Build a web app that lets users upload CSV files and instantly generate interactive charts and summary statistics.
problemStatement: Non-technical users struggle to extract insights from raw data. This tool makes data exploration accessible by auto-generating visualizations from any uploaded CSV file.
features: Interactive bar, line, and pie charts
implementationSteps: Set up Streamlit app with file upload component
Parse CSV with Pandas and auto-detect data types
Generate appropriate charts with Matplotlib based on column types
Add summary statistics, export options, and deploy to Streamlit Cloud

title: Movie Recommendation Engine
description: Build a content-based movie recommendation system using cosine similarity on movie metadata and user preferences.
problemStatement: Finding movies matching personal taste is overwhelming. This engine analyzes movie genres, cast, and descriptions to suggest similar titles based on user preferences.
features: Search by title for similar movies
implementationSteps: Load and clean MovieLens or TMDB dataset with Pandas
Engineer features from genres, cast, and descriptions
Implement cosine similarity matrix for content-based recommendations
Build Streamlit interface for search and recommendation display

title: Customer Segmentation Dashboard
description: Use K-Means clustering to segment customers based on purchasing behavior and build an interactive analytics dashboard.
problemStatement: Businesses need to understand customer groups for targeted marketing. This project clusters customers by RFM analysis and visualizes segments in an interactive dashboard.
features: Interactive Plotly scatter and radar charts
implementationSteps: Clean and preprocess e-commerce transaction dataset
Engineer RFM features and apply K-Means with optimal K selection
Build interactive Plotly visualizations for cluster exploration
Create Dash dashboard with filters and segment profile cards

title: Real-Time Stock Market Predictor
description: Build a real-time stock prediction pipeline using LSTM networks with streaming data ingestion and live monitoring dashboards.
problemStatement: Financial markets generate massive real-time data streams. This system combines LSTM-based price prediction with streaming architecture for live market analysis and trading signals.
features: Real-time stock data ingestion via API
implementationSteps: Set up data ingestion pipeline with Yahoo Finance API and Kafka
Engineer time-series features and train LSTM model on historical data
Build real-time prediction pipeline with sliding window inference
Create Grafana dashboard and implement backtesting framework

title: Static Website Deployer
description: Learn cloud basics by deploying a static website to AWS S3 with CloudFront CDN and a custom domain.
problemStatement: Beginners find cloud deployment intimidating. This project teaches core AWS concepts by deploying a static site with S3 hosting, CloudFront distribution, and DNS configuration.
features: S3 bucket creation and static hosting setup
implementationSteps: Create AWS account and build a simple HTML/CSS portfolio site
Configure S3 bucket for static website hosting with permissions
Set up CloudFront distribution and SSL certificate
Write bash deployment script and configure custom domain

title: Cloud-Based File Storage System
description: Develop a Dropbox-like cloud file storage system with user authentication, folder management, and file sharing.
problemStatement: Understanding cloud storage APIs is essential for modern development. This project teaches S3 integration, presigned URLs, and access control while building a practical file management app.
features: File upload and download via S3
implementationSteps: Set up AWS S3 and configure IAM permissions and CORS
Build Express API with multipart upload and presigned URL generation
Implement user authentication and folder management
Create React frontend with drag-and-drop upload and deploy

title: Serverless REST API with Auto-Scaling
description: Build a production-grade serverless API using Lambda functions with infrastructure-as-code deployment and monitoring.
problemStatement: Managing server infrastructure is costly and complex. This project demonstrates serverless architecture with automatic scaling, pay-per-use pricing, and infrastructure-as-code best practices.
implementationSteps: Design API endpoints and DynamoDB schema with access patterns
Write Lambda functions for CRUD operations with error handling
Create Terraform modules for Lambda, API Gateway, and DynamoDB
Set up CloudWatch dashboards, alerts, and CI/CD pipeline

title: Multi-Cloud Kubernetes Platform
description: Design a multi-cloud Kubernetes platform with service mesh, centralized monitoring, and automated failover between AWS and GCP.
problemStatement: Vendor lock-in and single-cloud outages threaten business continuity. This platform provides multi-cloud orchestration with automated failover, ensuring high availability across providers.
features: Istio service mesh for traffic management
implementationSteps: Provision EKS and GKE clusters with Terraform modules
Deploy Istio service mesh with cross-cluster communication
Set up Prometheus federation and Grafana dashboards
Implement automated failover logic and ArgoCD GitOps pipeline

title: Crypto Wallet Balance Checker
description: Build a web app that checks Ethereum wallet balances and displays recent transaction history using blockchain APIs.
problemStatement: Understanding how to interact with blockchain data is the first step in Web3 development. This project teaches blockchain API integration by querying wallet data from the Ethereum network.
implementationSteps: Set up React project and get Infura API key for Ethereum access
Use Ethers.js to query wallet balance and format output
Fetch and display recent transactions with block explorer links
Add USD price conversion and network switching

title: Token-Based Crowdfunding dApp
description: Build a decentralized crowdfunding platform where users create campaigns, contribute ETH, and receive ERC-20 tokens as proof of contribution.
problemStatement: Traditional crowdfunding platforms charge high fees and lack transparency. This dApp provides fee-free, transparent fundraising with blockchain-verified contributions and automatic refunds if goals aren't met.
features: Automatic refund if goal not met
implementationSteps: Write Solidity smart contract for campaign creation and contributions
Deploy to Hardhat local network and write unit tests
Build React frontend with MetaMask wallet connection
Implement contribution flow, progress tracking, and deploy to testnet

title: Smart Contract Voting System
description: Create a fully decentralized voting system with tamper-proof ballots, voter verification, and transparent result tabulation on-chain.
problemStatement: Centralized voting systems are vulnerable to manipulation. This dApp ensures each vote is immutably recorded on the blockchain with cryptographic voter verification and public auditability.
implementationSteps: Design and write Solidity voting contract with access control
Implement voter registration and one-person-one-vote logic
Build React frontend with MetaMask integration and vote casting UI
Add IPFS for candidate data, deploy to testnet, and audit

title: Cross-Chain DEX Aggregator
description: Build a decentralized exchange aggregator that finds optimal swap routes across multiple chains and DEXes for best pricing.
problemStatement: DeFi liquidity is fragmented across chains and protocols. This aggregator routes trades through optimal paths across Uniswap, SushiSwap, and cross-chain bridges for minimum slippage.
features: Optimal route finding with split routing
implementationSteps: Build price feed aggregation from multiple DEX subgraphs via TheGraph
Implement routing algorithm for optimal trade execution paths
Write smart contracts for batched swaps and cross-chain bridging
Create React frontend with swap interface and portfolio tracking

title: Shell Script Automation Toolkit
description: Create a collection of useful shell scripts for automating common development tasks like backups, log rotation, and deployment.
problemStatement: Repetitive system tasks waste developer time. This toolkit teaches shell scripting fundamentals by automating real daily tasks like backups, log management, and project setup.
implementationSteps: Learn bash fundamentals and write backup script with tar/gzip
Create log rotation script with date-based archival
Build project scaffolding generator with templating
Set up cron jobs for automated execution and document usage

title: Docker Development Environment
description: Build a containerized development environment with Docker Compose for a full-stack app with database, API, and reverse proxy.
problemStatement: 'Works on my machine' problems plague development teams. This project creates reproducible development environments using Docker Compose with hot-reloading and persistent data.
implementationSteps: Write Dockerfiles for Node.js API and React frontend
Create Docker Compose config with PostgreSQL and Nginx services
Configure Nginx reverse proxy and persistent database volumes
Add hot-reload support and document setup instructions

title: CI/CD Pipeline Automation
description: Automate full application deployment with CI/CD pipelines including testing, Docker image building, and blue-green deployment to AWS.
problemStatement: Manual deployments are error-prone and slow. This project implements a production-grade CI/CD pipeline with automated testing, container registry, and zero-downtime deployments.
features: GitHub Actions CI pipeline with test stages
Docker image build and registry push
implementationSteps: Set up GitHub Actions workflows for test, build, and deploy stages
Containerize application and push to ECR with semantic versioning
Write Terraform modules for ECS, ALB, and blue-green target groups
Implement deploy status notifications and rollback procedures
